facts.claim: In 1795 a school was founded by Antonio de Soura to educate Roman Catholic children of Mazagon, funded by interest on a Rs 40,000 endowment.
facts.quote: In 1795 n school svas founded by Antonio de Soura for the free education of the Roman Catholic children of Mazagon, the cost being defrayed from the interest on a sum of Rs. 40,000 ss-hich he gave to the Trustees of the church of Our Lady of Glory,
